notes: PRC summon-duration correction. User logs show PRC_SUMMON_ROUND_PER_LEVEL=1 together with PRC_MULTISUMMON=1. That switch intentionally changes summons from their normal listed duration (including Summon Creature's 24 hours) to caster-level rounds, explaining ~24-30 seconds at CL 4-5. Xanos init/attach now forces only PRC_SUMMON_ROUND_PER_LEVEL=0 while leaving PRC_MULTISUMMON unchanged, so each summon spell uses its own normal duration again. Existing 0.8.6.22 UI, vulnerability-aware ammo, reader prefetch, DR/boots, combat core 0.7.10.7 and PRC familiar FIX5 remain unchanged.
